detachments.name: Deffwing
detachments.unlock: When a Mega Warboss Unit is selected to fill a High Command Force Organisation Slot, then the Player may choose to add one Deffwing Detachment to the Army instead of the options available in the Crusade Force Organisation Chart.
restrictions: Heavy Assault Slots in this Detachment may only be used to select Meganobz Mob Units.

detachments.name: Boss's Bodyguard
detachments.note: No unlock paragraph or restriction bullet is printed in this Detachment's box on page 4; only the title and the three slot icons appear.

detachments.name: Green Tide
detachments.note: No unlock paragraph or restriction bullet is printed in this Detachment's box on page 4; only the title and the six slot icons (two Prime Slots, one per row) appear.

detachments.name: Dread Mob
detachments.unlock: When a Kustom Meka-dread Unit is selected to fill a High Command Force Organisation Slot, then the Player may choose to add one Dread Mob Detachment to the Army instead of the options available in the Crusade Force Organisation Chart.
restrictions: Support Slots in this Detachment may only be used to select Killa Kan Mob Units.

detachments.name: Kult of Speed
detachments.unlock: When a Big Mek Unit or Big Mek on Warbike Unit (but not a Mega Big Mek Unit) is selected to fill a Command Force Organization Slot, then the Player may choose to add one Kult of Speed Detachment to the Army instead of the options available in the Crusade Force Organisation Chart.
restrictions: Recon Slots in this Detachment may only be used to select Deffkoptas Units.
